hypothesis: The principal's twelve hand-selected basketball functions retain enough stable signal to match the full five-year SPM on next-season team wins.

model_contract.feature_grain: one complete rolling five-year player window
model_contract.target: zero-prior five-year RAPM over the identical seasons
model_contract.learner: separate offense and defense ridge regressions
model_contract.feature_selection: the first twelve metrics named by the principal, frozen before scoring
model_contract.feature_standardization: same-window player z-score, then training-only pipeline scaling
model_contract.sample_weight: square root of the smaller five-year offensive and defensive possession exposure

evaluation.primary: next-season team-win association using observed next-season minutes
evaluation.secondary: next-season one-year zero-prior RAPM on identical player rows

decision_rule: Retain as a research challenger only if mean team-win R-squared does not decline versus the full five-year SPM. Do not promote publicly before Season 2027.
stopping_rules: Do not tune the feature list or ridge alpha after reading these historical results.
Do not use Season 2027 for development or debugging.
Do not run an AIO posterior update unless the hand-selected SPM survives this gate.
